scenes.title: Invocation
scenes.purpose: The storyteller's frame: name the tale and its source, then open the box.
scenes.why: Invocation role: the viewer knows whose telling this is before the story starts.
scenes.visual: Lamp-lit paper, a lotus border draws, title words rise, the source cartouche slides in; kaavad doors open onto the world.

layout.portrait: Cartouche top-left in the safe area, title below it, doors in the middle third

scenes.title: World
scenes.purpose: Lay out the world of the story in paper.
scenes.why: World role: the order that the trial will disturb.
scenes.visual: Sky disc and clouds, far peaks, hills and waves are placed by hand one plane at a time; slow parallax push.

transition_out.continuity: The diorama persists; the gateway is added to it.

scenes.title: Revelation
scenes.purpose: The god or hero appears and is identified by an emblem.
scenes.why: Revelation role: the viewer can recognise the figure for the rest of the film.
scenes.visual: A gateway arch is placed; the figure rises inside it; a prabhavali blooms behind it and gold glints; the hand lifts.

beats.action: Camera pushes in on the figure

scenes.title: Trial and turn
scenes.purpose: The test or threat, then the turn.
scenes.why: Trial and turn roles: the stakes and the moment the story changes.
scenes.visual: Palette swaps to vermilion and ink, embers rise, the figure raises its arm; the palette returns and the lamp is carried to the figure.

scenes.title: Aftermath, teaching, closing
scenes.purpose: The world changed; the tradition's reading; close on the lamp.
scenes.why: Aftermath, teaching and closing roles: the change, its meaning as the tradition reads it, and the source.
scenes.visual: A lotus is placed at the front, blossoms fall, the teaching line rises, credits appear, the lamp returns to the centre and dims.

beats.action: Camera pulls back to the opening framing
